note: Public write-only key for the project's own collector (collector/ in this repository; Vercel fra1 with Neon Postgres; it keeps only daily counters, no events, no ids and no IP, for 365 days). It only lets a client add an event; it cannot read anything. Forks can point FO_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT and FO_TELEMETRY_KEY at their own collector or any PostHog-compatible capture endpoint.
